units.source_text: 大女公子回到房中，心甚忧虑：

en.t: The elder princess returned to her room, deeply troubled at heart:

units.source_text: 不知侍女等对昨夜之事如何猜想。

en.t: she did not know what the serving women were imagining about what had happened the night before.

units.source_text: 她不能立刻就寝，反复寻思：

en.t: She could not go to sleep at once, and kept turning the matter over in her mind:

units.source_text: “没有父母，为人在世真苦。

en.t: Without parents, it is truly hard to live in this world.

units.source_text: 身边的人会干种种恶事，花样层出不穷，从中作弄摆布。

en.t: People around one may do all kinds of wicked things, devising endless tricks to manipulate and torment one.

units.source_text: 结果难免发生意外之变，真可忧啊！”

en.t: In the end some unexpected calamity is bound to occur; it is truly frightening!

units.source_text: 又想：“这个人的举止态度，并无可厌之处。

en.t: Then she thought again: There is nothing disagreeable in this man's bearing or conduct.

units.source_text: 父亲在世之时，也是如此看法，

en.t: When my father was alive, he saw him in the same way,

units.source_text: 常说此人如果有意求婚，倒可许得。

en.t: and often said that if this man wished to propose, the match could well be accepted.

units.source_text: 但我自己总是独身到底了。

en.t: But I myself will remain single to the end.

units.source_text: 妹妹比我年轻，且又长得貌美，埋没一生，未免可惜。

en.t: My younger sister is younger than I am, and beautiful as well; it would be a pity for her to spend her whole life hidden away.

units.source_text: 倘能像别人一般嫁个称意夫婿，实为可喜之事。

en.t: If she could marry a husband she liked, as other women do, it would truly be a happy thing.

units.source_text: 这两人之事，我一定尽心竭力地玉成。

en.t: I will do everything in my power to bring these two together.

units.source_text: 但倘是我自身之事，又有谁来照料呢？

en.t: But if it were a matter concerning myself, who would be there to look after it?

units.source_text: 此人倘是并不惹人注目的寻常男子，

en.t: If this man were an ordinary man who did not draw people's attention,

units.source_text: 那么为了报答他多年来爱护之恩，我也不妨折节相从。

en.t: then, to repay the affection he has shown me over the years, I might even humble myself and yield to him.

units.source_text: 可是此人气宇轩昂，令人望而却步，

en.t: But this man has such a noble and imposing presence that it makes one shrink back,

units.source_text: 反而使我不敢亲近。

en.t: and it only makes me afraid to draw near him.

units.source_text: 我还不如独身度送此生吧。”

en.t: I would be better off passing this life alone after all.

units.source_text: 她左思右想，啜泣直至天明。

en.t: She thought this way and that, sobbing softly until dawn.

units.source_text: 悲痛之余，心情恶劣，便走进二女公子所卧的内室中，睡在她身旁了。

en.t: Overcome with grief and feeling wretched, she went into the inner room where the younger princess was sleeping and lay down beside her.

units.source_text: 二女公子听见众侍女窃窃私议，情状与平时不同，

en.t: The younger princess had heard the serving women whispering among themselves and sensed that things were different from usual,

units.source_text: 独自躺着，心中正在疑怪。

en.t: and as she lay there alone, she was wondering uneasily what was going on.

units.source_text: 看见姐姐进来睡在她身旁，不胜之喜，

en.t: When she saw her elder sister come in and lie down beside her, she was overjoyed,

units.source_text: 连忙拿衣服来替她盖上。

en.t: and hurriedly brought a robe to cover her.

units.source_text: 忽然闻到姐姐身上发散出一种浓烈的衣香，无疑是薰君身上所有的。

en.t: Suddenly she smelled a strong fragrance of perfumed robes rising from her sister, unmistakably the scent that belonged to Lord Kaoru.

units.source_text: 她想起了那值宿人难于处理的那件衣服，

en.t: She remembered the robe that had caused such difficulty for the night attendant,

units.source_text: 推想侍女们所窃窃私议的确是事实了，便觉姐姐很是可怜。

en.t: and concluded that what the serving women had been whispering about must indeed be true, which made her feel very sorry for her sister.

units.source_text: 她就装作睡着的样子，一言不发。

en.t: So she pretended to be asleep and did not say a word.
